entries.title: Psalms 9:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.>> I will praise [thee], O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

entries.title: Psalms 9:2
segments: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

words.text: in thee: I will sing praise

entries.title: Psalms 9:3
segments: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

entries.title: Psalms 9:4
segments: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right. {maintained...: Heb. made my judgment} {judging right: Heb. judging in righteousness}

words.text: . {maintained...: Heb. made my judgment} {judging right: Heb. judging in righteousness}

entries.title: Psalms 9:5
segments: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:6
segments: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them. {O thou...: or, The destructions of the enemy are come to a perpetual end: and their cities hast thou destroyed, etc}

words.text: . {O thou...: or, The destructions of the enemy are come to a perpetual end: and their cities hast thou destroyed, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 9:7
segments: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 9:8
segments: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 9:9
segments: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble. {a refuge: Heb. an high place}

entries.title: Psalms 9:10
segments: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

entries.title: Psalms 9:11
segments: ¶Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

entries.title: Psalms 9:12
segments: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble. {humble: or, afflicted}

entries.title: Psalms 9:13
segments: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble [which I suffer] of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

words.text: [which I suffer] of them that hate
me, thou that liftest me up

entries.title: Psalms 9:14
segments: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 9:15
segments: The heathen are sunk down in the pit [that] they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

entries.title: Psalms 9:16
segments: The LORD is known [by] the judgment [which] he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah. {Higgaion: that is, Meditation}

entries.title: Psalms 9:17
segments: The wicked shall be turned into hell, [and] all the nations that forget God.

entries.title: Psalms 9:18
segments: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall [not] perish for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:19
segments: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

entries.title: Psalms 9:20
segments: Put them in fear, O LORD: [that] the nations may know themselves [to be but] men. Selah.
